capabilities.name: Recurring/subscription invoices
capabilities.verify: LIVE E2E VERIFIED on rzhj 2026-07-05 after the due-guard deployed (Stage-3): create_manual_subscription (10000 SEK/month) → generate_subscription_invoice produced SUB-20260705-84457 total 12500 (exact 25% tax) and advanced next_invoice_date 2026-07-05 → 2026-08-05; an IMMEDIATE second call was REFUSED with 'not due: next invoice date is 2026-08-05 (already invoiced through the current period)' — the double-billing guard works; cancel clean, test data removed. Mechanism: subscription-billing-cron + generate_subscription_invoice (due-guard + anniversary-preserving advance, migration 20260705150000) + subscriptions.next_invoice_date/billing_interval
capabilities.notes: Was NOT idempotent until 2026-07-05 (second same-day call double-billed the period and late runs shifted the billing anniversary) — caught live, fixed (20260705150000), redeployed and re-verified live. Remaining depth: proration (P1.1); card-provider recurring is Stripe-native.

capabilities.name: Credit/debit notes
capabilities.verify: LIVE E2E VERIFIED on rzhj 2026-07-04 (Stage-3, after the cumulative-guard fix deployed): invoice INV-2026-00015 (12500) → create_credit_note 5000 → CN with total_cents=-5000, already_credited_cents=0, remaining_creditable_cents=7500; create_credit_note 10000 → correctly REJECTED ('Credit 10000 exceeds remaining creditable amount 7500 (invoice total 12500, already credited 5000)'). Mechanism: invoices.invoice_type + credited_invoice_id + create_credit_note RPC/skill (full negates remaining, partial = -amount, cumulative over-credit rejected; migrations 20260614090000 → 20260627220000 → 20260704181000) + admin UI: CreditNoteDialog (full/partial + reason) launched from InvoiceDetailSheet 'Issue Credit Note'
capabilities.notes: Was broken by a PER-CALL (not cumulative) over-credit guard: it compared a single credit against the invoice total but not against already-issued credits, so two partial credits (5000 then 10000 on a 12500 invoice) both passed → -15000 credited, an AR-integrity break. Caught by live verification 2026-07-04; the 2026-06-14 scratch check only exercised a single over-total credit. Fixed: create_credit_note now sums existing credit notes and rejects when the running total would exceed the total; full credit negates the REMAINING balance; a fully-credited invoice is rejected (deployed via Lovable bundle migration 20260704211755 (re-emits create_credit_note with the cumulative guard), superseding 20260614090000 + 20260627220000). Fix deployed and re-verified live. Remaining follow-up (not blocking done): ledger reversal posting on credit-note issue.

capabilities.name: Partial/over/under payment handling
capabilities.verify: LIVE E2E VERIFIED on rzhj 2026-07-04 (Stage-3 evidence): created invoice INV-2026-00013 (total 12500) via manage_invoice, then record_invoice_payment 5000 → remaining_cents=7500 paid_amount=5000; record_invoice_payment 20000 → correctly REJECTED ('Payment 20000 exceeds remaining balance 7500'); record_invoice_payment 7500 → remaining_cents=0, status='paid', paid_amount=12500. Mechanism: invoices.paid_amount_cents tracked by reconcile_invoice_payments (bank path) + record_invoice_payment RPC/skill (manual partial payments, overpay rejected, status→paid when settled) (migration 20260614100000) + admin UI: RecordPaymentDialog (prefilled outstanding balance, client-side overpay guard) launched from InvoiceDetailSheet 'Record Payment', paid/total progress shown on invoice detail
capabilities.notes: Bank-rec partial/over/under already existed; manual payment path added and now runtime-verified end-to-end (partial → overpay-reject → settle → paid). UI shipped 2026-07-03 (src/components/admin/invoices/RecordPaymentDialog.tsx). · 2026-09-19 process battery: a deposit is not booked until the invoice is fully paid; record_invoice_payment has a 4- and a 5-arg overload, ambiguous without p_reference (quote-to-cash). Back to done when the known-red check is green.

capabilities.name: AR aging report
capabilities.verify: LIVE E2E VERIFIED on rzhj 2026-07-04 (Stage-3, after the fix deployed): ar_aging_report() returned success:true with real buckets (total_outstanding_cents=53,712,500; current 53,675,000; overdue_1_30 37,500) and a per-customer breakdown (Niklas Frost 40M, Lisa Operations 13.5M, …) — no per_customer error. Mechanism: buckets open invoices (total_cents - paid_amount_cents > 0, invoice_type='invoice', status<>cancelled) per customer into current/1-30/31-60/61-90/90+ days overdue vs due_date; admin UI: 'Aging Report' tab on /admin/invoices (src/components/admin/invoices/ArAgingReportTab.tsx)
capabilities.notes: Was briefly broken by a latent CTE-scope bug (the totals SELECT referenced the per_customer CTE out of scope → 'relation "per_customer" does not exist'), caught by live verification 2026-07-04 and fixed by aggregating the already-computed v_customers array (migration 20260703140000 corrected in place; the deployed fix is Lovable bundle migration 20260704211755, which re-emits ar_aging_report with the corrected body). Fix deployed to rzhj and re-verified live. A clean example of static inspection passing while runtime failed — Stage-3 rule vindicated.
